outcome: Reasons for preferring OBS or tubal ligation
cohort: 54 women who underwent surgical sterilization with either OBS or tubal ligation
finding: The acceptance rate of opportunistic bilateral salpingectomy (OBS) at the time of cesarean section was very high (93.5%), and the main driving factors influencing the decision of preferring OBS over tubal ligation were the risk-reducing effect for ovarian cancer and superior pregnancy prevention.
